alt: Heather Headley, florist and owner of Heather Florals
caption: Heather Headley. Heather Florals, Northeast Alabama.

alt: The Bloom Bar — Heather's converted horse trailer mobile flower station
caption: The Bloom Bar. A converted horse trailer. The most photographed corner at every wedding she does. It was her idea.

alt: Heather Florals bouquets at the farmers market
caption: Saturday morning. Bouquets on the table. She sold them from the farm kiosk while the kids ran in the grass.

alt: A pink bouquet in Heather's hand
caption: She asks what your grandmother grew in her backyard and builds something from there.
She doesn't hand you a laminated menu.

alt: The greenhouse at Headley Flower Farm
caption: Nine acres near the Chief Ladiga Trail. A 1832 farmhouse. A greenhouse. A life we built together.

alt: Heather running the Chief Ladiga Trail, 2015
caption: Chief Ladiga Trail, 2015. She was there before the farm. She was there after.

alt: Heather and Matt at Headley Flower Farm
caption: Heather and Matt. The farm. She was the steady anchor before she was supposed to be well enough to be anything.
